newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA silent on Air NZ.
newsitem.headline: SIA silent on Air NZ.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said Friday it declined to comment on a report that it could be buying a stake in Air New Zealand Ltd.

"Airlines all over the world are constantly talking to one another about various forms of co-operation and alliances. We are no exception. To avoid unnecessary speculation, we have adopted the policy of not responding to any questions on this subject," Kamjit Singh, SIA's assistant director of corporate affairs, said in a statement.
New Zealand's Independent Business Weekly reported that SIA was likely to buy some, if not all of Quantas Airways' 19.4 percent stake in Air NZ.
Quantas' stake in Air NZ is worth about NZ$318 million.
Air NZ spokesman David Beatson told the Independent the company would announce an alliance with another airline in either Asia, the U.S. or Europe within weeks.
"Now that we have settled the Ansett arrangement, we are looking at how we can capitalise on that," he said.
Air NZ bought 50 percent of Australian airline company Ansett Holdings earlier this year.
SIA was also one of the interested parties courting Ansett before Air NZ sealed the deal.
